comment: DEMO KEYS ONLY — for local testing, never for a public deployment. On a real host, set the API_KEYS_JSON environment variable with freshly generated keys (same JSON shape); it overrides this file. In production, subscriber keys are issued by the marketplace (RapidAPI injects its own key header) or by a billing-backed key service. Every key carries a scope: {type: all} is unrestricted; {type: state, state: LA} is bound to one full state (Full State Heavy, $59/mo); {type: city, state: LA, city: Ville Platte} is bound to one city (City Heavy, $29/mo). Out-of-scope records are excluded from results, never leaked.
